_read_me: All home page copy lives here. Edit the text in quotes and keep the {n} markers: the site fills each {n} with a live count from the database. An "art" value of null keeps the current illustration; set it to an image address, or to SVG markup beginning <svg, to replace it.

site.title: The Syren Protocols
site.description: Some cities are buried. Some are documented. In 2034 Warsaw was both. What follows is what survived.
site._placeholder_read_me: Shown on any entry that has no images of its own, marked PLACEHOLDER. A real image replaces it automatically. To change it, upload a new placeholder.jpg to the images bucket. To switch it off, set the value below to an empty string.

hero.headline: When memory becomes a weapon,
hero.intro: Some cities are buried. Some are documented. In 2034 Warsaw was both. What follows is what survived.
hero.intro_secondary: Assembling testimony from a city that no longer exists as we knew it.

grid._read_me: The seven category tiles. title is the large heading, code and label make the line beneath it, text is the description. Counts are live. art is a picture placed behind the tile graphic: null for none, or an image address.

index.text: Sort, filter and open any of the {n} entries.

portal.heading: One project, four ways in
portal._read_me: The four cards, in this order. title is the large heading, code and label make the line beneath it, text is the description ({n} is the live entry count). href is where the card goes (search opens the search box); leave it empty for a card that is not ready yet, and put a word such as Coming in status. art is a picture placed behind the graphic: null for none, or an image address.
